_README: Video settings for an RTX 5070 (12 GB) + Ryzen 7 7700X at 2560x1440, 240 Hz, competitive (latency first, then clarity). menu = the in-game Settings > Video label and value. keys = the Source 2 video file keys tools/vw_video.py sets, ONLY when the key already exists in the file the game wrote (it never adds a key). Keys checked against the file the game wrote on first launch (2026-10-25, Version 20): only keys whose value range is unambiguous are set here; upscaling, shadow, anti-aliasing and particle values stay menu-only. See docs/optimization.md.

menu.Upscaling: Off (native); DLSS Quality only if 1 percent lows fall under 160 fps. Menu only: the game picked DLSS Quality (render scale 0.6667) on first launch and the upscaler enum is not written from the file
menu.Anti-Aliasing: Low or Off if Upscaling is On (menu only)
menu.Particle Quality: Low (clearer fights; menu only, no file key)

_keys_notes.setting.r_low_latency: NVIDIA Reflex: 0 off, 1 on, 2 on + boost
_keys_notes.setting.fullscreen: 1 with nowindowborder 0 = exclusive fullscreen (first launch wrote borderless: 0 / 1)
_keys_notes.setting.refreshrate_numerator: first launch wrote 0/0 (desktop default); the display runs exactly 240 Hz
